title: hemiphlebium lineolatum
intro: Hemiphlebium lineolatum, commonly known as the 'Rabbit's Foot Fern', is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hemiphlebium lineolatum include soothing irritated skin, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using Hemiphlebium lineolatum for medicinal purposes.
